programs.title: Blue World
programs.sub_title: Hammerhead Sharks in the Bahamas + Playing With Dolphins
programs.desc: We experience Great Hammerhead sharks that often like to swim very close to divers. Then Blue World divers play a game of keep away with a pod of wild Spotted Dolphins.

programs.title: Private Islands
programs.desc: Escaping to the private island of Pulau Joyo in Indonesia, where visitors enjoy Indonesian food against a backdrop of crystal blue waters and awe-inspiring sunsets.

programs.title: Behind the Gates
programs.desc: A VIP open house of spectacular estates and mega-mansions in California, Florida and New Jersey.

programs.title: Travel Thru History
programs.desc: Heading to the great white North, kind of; we visit the city of Toronto; there we'll head straight up the Western Hemisphere's tallest structure, the CN Tower; we score a look at the Hockey Hall of Fame.

programs.title: 5 Star Getaways
programs.desc: Roatan, a large island located in the bay of Honduras; several excursions attract many travelers such as diving in one of the biggest coral reefs of the Caribbean Sea.

programs.title: Selling Mega Mansions
programs.desc: Alana and Stephen tour a contemporary mansion in the Benedict Canyon area of Beverly Hills; Alexi and Shannon view the model and showroom for a yet to be built Miami Beach masterpiece.
